segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ בְּכוֹר שֶׁנִּסְמֵית עֵינוֹ, וְשֶׁנִּקְטְעָה יָדוֹ, וְשֶׁנִּשְׁבְּרָה רַגְלוֹ — הֲרֵי זֶה יִשָּׁחֵט עַל פִּי שְׁלֹשָׁה בְּנֵי הַכְּנֶסֶת. רַבִּי יוֹסֵי אוֹמֵר: אֲפִילּוּ יֵשׁ שָׁם עֶשְׂרִים וּשְׁלֹשָׁה, אֵינוֹ נִשְׁחָט אֶלָּא עַל פִּי מוּמְחֶה.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» With regard to «a firstborn» animal «whose eye was blinded or whose foreleg was severed or whose hind leg was broken,» all of which obviously render the animal permanently blemished, that animal «may be slaughtered on the basis of» the ruling of «three» regular Jews «who attend the synagogue,» and it does not require a ruling by one of the Sages. «Rabbi Yosei» disagrees and «says: Even if there is» a court of «twenty-three» Sages «there, it may be slaughtered only on the basis of» the ruling of «an expert» in judging blemishes.
